no_api_findings.finding: The versioned standard-library package list contains no Netpbm/PNM decoder. image.Decode dispatches only to registered image decoders; the standard library has no P1, P2, or P3 registration. image/png parses PNG, not PNM. Generic file and binary readers do not interpret PNM headers or pixels.

limit: This finding covers documented Go 1.27.1 standard-library APIs. Third-party image format registrations and system graphics libraries are separate.
